mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_presence (user_id, status, last_seen_at, activity_type, activity_name, activity_started_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{now}, #{activityType}, #{activityName}, CASE WHEN CAST(#{activityName} AS VARCHAR) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) END, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, activity_type = EXCLUDED.activity_type, activity_name = EXCLUDED.activity_name, activity_started_at = CASE WHEN user_presence.activity_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.activity_type AND user_presence.activity_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.activity_name THEN user_presence.activity_started_at ELSE EXCLUDED.activity_started_at END, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT user_id AS userId, status, last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, activity_type AS activityType, activity_name AS activityName, activity_started_at AS activityStartedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_presence WHERE user_id IN
CAST(#{userId} AS UUID)
